summary: ZenaTech, Inc. filed Form 6-K on June 3, 2026, containing unaudited consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and MD&A. The filing is a routine quarterly report by a foreign private issuer, incorporated by reference into an effective F-3 registration statement. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The report solely provides financial performance updates, with no transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors noted. The filing is standard for ongoing SEC reporting obligations.
